planets.name: KOI-4777 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of KOI-4777 with a 0.412-day year, found in 2022.

text.card: KOI-4777 b was found in 2022 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around KOI-4777. Its orbit and size follow Cañas et al. 2022's fit, the archive's default.
